title: Energy density: q squared
spoken: Energy density scales by q squared.
explanation: The energy per cubic metre of the light changes by the square of the frequency ratio. At q = 0.5 it falls to a quarter.
assumptions: The moving system moves along x at speed v relative to the stationary system, with |v| < c. Modern teaching notation: gamma is the paper's beta, c its V.
A bounded piece of plane light whose surface moves with the light. q is the frequency ratio of section 7 for this light's direction.
Energy density, volume and total energy are three different quantities, and each has its own factor.

notes.title: Moving over stationary
notes.explanation: How the density changes between the systems.

notes.title: What it asserts
notes.explanation: A statement about density only. The whole packet's energy changes differently, because its volume changes too.

notes.title: q squared
notes.explanation: The density goes as the square of the amplitude, and the amplitude changes by q.

notes.title: Energy density, stationary system
notes.explanation: The light's energy per cubic metre in the stationary system.

notes.title: Energy density, moving system
notes.explanation: The light's energy per cubic metre in the moving system.

notes.title: The frequency ratio
notes.explanation: Section 7's q, for this light's direction. At 0.6c, for light along the motion, q = 0.5.

sentence.text: The energy density in the moving system
